Every player starts as a civilian arriving at the central terminal of the metropolis. No job, no car, no reputation — just a phone, an ID and whatever you can earn in your first hours. The guided tour On your first join, a third person guided tour walks you through the key districts: Police Station — arrests, reports and jail time General Hospital — the EMS corps Central Bank — deposits, withdrawals, loans Dealership — where vehicles are sold Residential Zone — apartments and houses You can replay it whenever you like: [!TIP] Do the tour even if you already know Minecraft. It shows the exact buildings you will need on day one, and the route between them is the fastest way to learn the map. Your smartphone and SIM You receive a smartphone in your inventory. It is required for calls, texts, the 911 line and money transfers. Your number is 5 digits , generated when your SIM is registered. T

Requirement Detail Tool Vault Drill (special item) Drilling time 50 seconds Alarm custom.robbery siren Consequence Assailants receive 3 wanted stars automatically Police response Live coordinates broadcast to every officer The heist loop 1. Assemble a crew. One person drilling, at least one watching the door. 2. Bring the drill. The item is consumed or required by the vault door. 3. Start drilling.
